regions.text: あるから阿片は健康に利が

quote.translation: An example would be to argue from the fact that "morphine is valuable as a medicine" that "since the main constituent of opium is morphine, opium is good for the health".

regions.text: ある」と主張するやうな場合である。麻酔劑または鎮痛劑を必要とする病盤といふ例外的偶然的事象と身體一般とを舞別しないために起る虚僞である。

quote.translation: The fallacy arises from failing to distinguish the exceptional, contingent case of a sick body in need of an anaesthetic or analgesic from the body in general.

regions.text: 「以上、例外的偶然を考察したのであるが、要するに、一般概念に對する非本質約教表が何外としての偶然微表である場合に、非本質性偶然性が特に浮出てくるのである。

quote.translation: We have considered exceptional contingency, and in sum, when a non-essential mark of a general concept is a contingent mark in the form of an exception, its non-essentiality, its contingency, stands out with particular force.

regions.text: 那先比丘経」のうちで瀰蘭が那先に次の問を發してある。

quote.translation: In the Nāgasena Sūtra (那先比丘經), Milinda puts the following question to Nāgasena: "People in the world all have heads, faces, eyes, bodies and four limbs complete.

regions.text: 「世間人頭面目身後四支皆完具何故有長命者有短命者有多病少病者有貧者富者有長者有專者有端正者有醜惡者有爲入所信者為人所疑者有明者有刷者何以故不同」多上）。

quote.translation: Why, then, are some long-lived and some short-lived, some often ill and some seldom ill, some poor and some rich, some honoured and some base, some handsome and some ugly, some trusted by others and some doubted, some bright and some dull?
Why are they not the same?"

regions.text: この間は入間の喜びと機みとを変する哲學的な間であるが畢意、個物の偶然性定言的偶然性に對する間にほかならない。

quote.translation: This is a philosophical question that holds within it human joy and suffering, yet in the end it is nothing other than a question about the contingency of the individual thing, about categorical contingency.

regions.text: 個々の人間が人間といふ一般概念に對

quote.translation: It is a question about the contingent determinations that individual human beings possess in relation to the general concept of the human.
